_説明: FLUX.1 schnell 用のキャラクター定義。Animagine XL 用の subjects.json とは書き方が違う(タグ列挙ではなく英文)ので別ファイルにしてある。元に戻したくなったら subjects.json + gen.py の方をそのまま使えばよい。
_ポーズ: 1体につき idle / cast / release / hurt の4枚を作る。姿かたちの説明は完全に同じ文を使い、末尾のポーズ文だけを差し替える。seed も4枚で同じにする。こうしないと同じキャラに見えない。
_向き: プレイヤーは右向き・敵は左向きが正しい。逆に描かれたものは flip に書けば左右反転する。ポーズごとに指定できる('player:3' で4枚とも / 'player:3:cast' でその1枚だけ)。
_向き補足: 被弾のポーズだけは相手に背を向けて正しい。攻撃を受けてのけぞる=相手から顔をそむける動きなので、向かい合わせに直すと『殴られて相手に突っ込む』絵になる。
_style: 背景の指定は style に混ぜず、style_head と style_tail の間に差し込む。光り物は黒背景で描かせる必要があり、白背景の指定が残っていると『白い四角』が切り抜かれずに残る(実際にウィスプで起きた)。
style_head: cute anime video game character art, japanese anime style, clean cel shading, crisp bold outlines, vibrant saturated colors, big expressive sparkling eyes, soft rounded cheeks, appealing cute character design, slightly stylized proportions with a large head, full body from head to feet, whole body inside the frame, centered
style_tail: no text, no watermark, no border, no frame
player_view: three-quarter view at a 45 degree angle, the character is turned 45 degrees to the right side, both the body and the head are rotated by the same amount, the shoulders are at 45 degrees to the camera, the face is seen in three-quarter view with the nose and one cheek in partial profile, both eyes still visible, clearly turned but still partly toward the viewer, definitely not a straight front facing pose and definitely not a full side profile
enemy_view: three-quarter view at a 45 degree angle, the character is turned 45 degrees to the left side, both the body and the head are rotated by the same amount, the shoulders are at 45 degrees to the camera, the face is seen in three-quarter view with the nose and one cheek in partial profile, both eyes still visible, clearly turned but still partly toward the viewer, definitely not a straight front facing pose and definitely not a full side profile
_player_body: 5体で頭身がばらばらだったので数で言い切る。見て感じる頭の大きさは髪込みなので、髪まで含めて全身の3分の1と書く。前傾になりやすいので背筋も指定する。
player_body: chibi super deformed, exactly three heads tall, the head including the hair is about one third of the total height, small compact body, short arms and short legs, standing upright with a straight back, not leaning forward and not hunched over, standing on the ground with both feet fully visible, entire body from the top of the head to the tips of the shoes inside the frame

player_poses.idle: standing calmly in a relaxed ready stance, gentle friendly expression
player_poses.cast: chanting a spell, both hands raised together in front of the chest, a glowing magic circle forming in the air beside the hands, eyes narrowed in concentration, hair and clothes lifted by magical wind
player_poses.release: unleashing the finished spell, both arms thrust forward with open palms, a bright burst of magical energy erupting from the hands, cape and hair blown backward, determined shouting expression
player_poses.hurt: struck by an attack and recoiling backward, head turned away, eyes squeezed shut, one arm raised defensively in front of the face, pained expression, small impact sparks

enemy_poses.idle: in a calm waiting idle pose
enemy_poses.cast: gathering magical power, a glowing magic circle forming in front of it, body hunched and charging up, glowing aura rising around it
enemy_poses.release: unleashing its attack, lunging forward with a bright burst of energy, mouth wide open roaring
enemy_poses.hurt: struck by a spell and recoiling backward, flinching hard, eyes squeezed shut, small impact sparks around it

_flip補足: FLUX は left / right の指示に従わず、種ごとに向きが変わる。作り直すと向き・頭身・姿勢が全部引き直されて別の所が崩れるので、絵は固定して反転だけで直すこと。
_flip敵: 56枚を1枚ずつ実寸で見て、右(プレイヤーと逆)を向いていたものだけを挙げてある。丸い相手ほど間違えやすい(一覧の小さい絵では向きが分からない)。

_player_view: 向きの指定は文の先頭に置く。末尾だと FLUX は従わず、ほぼ正面で描いてしまう。顔と体を別々に書くのが肝心で、体だけ書くと「体は斜め・顔は正面」のちぐはぐな絵になる。左右は指示しても従わないので、出てきた絵を見て flip で直す。
_enemy_view: プレイヤーと同じ考え方。完全な横向きではなく、少し正面に体を向けた45度にする。
